description: One tax document (invoice) of the self-employed tax books, by id (from list_tax_documents): dates (invoice, operation, registration, accrual), fiscal amount, tax base and VAT (per rate when the invoice has several), VAT exemption, income-tax withholding, intra-community or reverse-charge treatment, deductible share for income tax and VAT (the document's own value or the one inherited from its category or tag), depreciation, tax-return box, and the payments linked to it. The client or supplier comes partially hidden unless `reveal_third_parties` is true; it is returned under `untrusted` with the notes and line descriptions. Read-only. Needs the self-employed module.

book.description: Account book id (from list_books). Optional if the user has only one.

reveal_third_parties.description: Full names and tax ids of clients, suppliers and payees. Default false: they come partially hidden (first letters of each word, first and last characters of the tax id).

name: get_tax_document
title: Tax document (invoice) details
